summary: Verified accent-insensitive patient search (Issue P2). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed for both endpoints (GET /api/patients and GET /api/pacientes/buscar) with all variants of 'María'/'Maria' (nombre) and 'García'/'Garcia' (apellido), including case-insensitive queries (maria, MARIA, MARÍA). Frontend: The Pacientes page search input correctly returns 'María García López' for queries 'Maria', 'María', 'Garcia', and 'García'. The bug fix using generate_accent_regex() with character class regex is working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: generate_accent_regex approach works but consider adding a MongoDB text index or 'collation: strength:1' for better performance at scale (currently uses regex on unindexed fields).
Patient POST schema mixes Spanish/English (nombre vs first_name); ensure consistent API contract across endpoints.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test patient 'María García López' (dni TEST99887766) if not already present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_accent_search.py covers 18 parametrized cases (5 nombre + 5 apellido for /api/patients; 4 nombre + 4 apellido for /api/pacientes/buscar). Patient POST requires English fields: first_name, last_name, birth_date, phone, gender (masculino/femenino/otro), referral_institution (particular/igss/seguro_privado/otra).
rca of the issue: Previous bug: MongoDB pipeline used $split with empty separator (unsupported). Fixed via generate_accent_regex() producing character classes like [aáàäâ] applied via case-insensitive regex on nombre/apellido/documento fields. Verified both endpoints and UI now match accented and unaccented queries bidirectionally.
